discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology moved from basic discovery of an incretin hormone to drugs that changed how diabetes and obesity are treated worldwide. It has won the Lasker, Breakthrough and Gairdner awards, and recent prizes (mRNA, microRNA, Tregs) suggest the committee is willing to reward foundational work with clear clinical impact. Habener and Mojsov identified and characterized active GLP-1, and Knudsen led the development of long-acting analogues (liraglutide, semaglutide).
